summary.intent: Bootstrap the release-please system (phase 41) with correct version tags, align api-client versions with the API, expose the API version on the /health endpoint, and fix the release preview workflow to commit release-as targets on the PR branch instead of pushing directly to main.
summary.outcome: All 15 bootstrap tags created and pushed, api-client versions aligned to 0.35.0, /health endpoint now returns version from package.json, and the pr-release-preview workflow was restructured to write release-as config to the PR branch on merge (eliminating the post-merge push-to-main approach that was blocked by branch protection).

repo: release-please treats the entire commit history as unreleased when no prior tags exist — bootstrap tags must be created manually on the pre-phase commit to scope changelogs correctly
The OpenAPI spec in packages/api-client/openapi.json had a hardcoded version '0.1.0' in both apps/api/src/main.ts and apps/api/scripts/generate-openapi.ts that was never updated

HealthController is excluded from the OpenApiGeneratorModule because it depends on TypeOrmHealthIndicator which requires a real DB connection — the health endpoint spec is defined manually in generate-openapi.ts instead

Phase 41 discussion log (41-DISCUSSION-LOG.md line 106) explicitly decided monotonic major.minor versioning for web and desktop apps, but the implementation used release-please's default semver — this decision was revisited and semver accepted as-is

The post-merge-release workflow tried to push release-as config directly to main, which is blocked by branch protection rules (12 required status checks); legacy branch protection rules don't support per-actor bypass unlike the newer Rulesets system
Merge commits with 2+ parents were being parsed as conventional commits by the PR release preview script, producing false-positive release labels across many packages
release-as targets in release-please-config.json must land on main before release-please runs — committing them to the release-please branch has no effect

code.finding: Version reading was duplicated here and in health.controller.ts — extracted to shared src/version.ts module

Health endpoint spec is manually defined here (not via controller introspection) because TypeOrmHealthIndicator can't be instantiated without a DB; the version property was missing from this manual spec initially
Commit loop originally processed merge commits — needed parent count check to skip them
openapi.json requires jsonpath specification for release-please to bump nested info.version field, not just a plain file path

Manual override labels (existing higher-or-equal label) were preserved in computedLabels but packageBumps was not updated, so release-as derivation in section 7.5 used the lower computed bump instead of the manual override

workflow: Using 'fix:' commit prefix triggers patch version bumps via release-please — CI/tooling fixes that shouldn't affect versioning should use 'chore(ci):' or 'chore:' prefix
Squashing multiple commits into one 'chore(ci):' before force-pushing prevents unintended release-please version bumps from earlier 'fix:' prefixed commits
PR review comment resolution: reply via REST API using --field for integer in_reply_to, resolve via GraphQL mutation — these are separate operations
GitHub Actions GITHUB_TOKEN pushes don't trigger new workflow runs (built-in recursion prevention), so there's no infinite loop risk when a workflow commits back to the PR branch
Conventional commit scopes (feat(api):, chore(ci):) are critical for release-please to correctly attribute changes to packages in a monorepo

friction: Legacy branch protection rules don't have per-actor bypass — had to uncheck 'Do not allow bypassing' broadly, which was still insufficient for the GitHub App to push to main
Cargo.lock regeneration pulled in unrelated dependency updates when bumping crate version — had to use targeted cargo update to update only workspace crates
git index.lock file left behind by a crashed git process required manual removal before switching branches
The executor agent was interrupted mid-run (classifyHandoffIfNeeded bug risk), requiring manual execution of the plan steps
Auto-merge wasn't actually enabled on PR #428 despite the user believing it was — PR had to be merged manually
PR #431's self-test (release preview running on itself) was a good validation but also slightly awkward — the workflow was modifying the branch it was triggered on
open_items: The remaining open tags push step: after PR #429 and #431 merge, bootstrap tags for newly aligned api-client versions (0.35.0) still need to be created if any are missing
Monotonic versioning for web/desktop apps was deferred — accepted semver for now but the original design decision (phase 41 discussion log) prefers major.minor for user-facing apps

The pr-release-preview.js packageBumps/manual override sync fix (lines 503-538) was applied at end of session — needs verification that release-as generation now correctly reflects manual label overrides
Re-enable 'Do not allow bypassing the above settings' in branch protection after the post-merge workflow was removed (user confirmed done for 'Do not allow bypassing' but worth noting)
The release-please config has openapi.json as an extra file with jsonpath — this should be verified to work correctly on the next actual API version bump
